tagline: The largest update since the plugin was created.

entries.headline: Embodied NPCs shared with the table, a lobby open to every party, turn-based combat with a tactical camera, and an online vault for your sheets and templates.

sections.title: NPCs
items: Place real characters in the zone: full appearance, held emotes, drawn weapon, position and facing.
The GM's NPCs appear for players in the same zone, with their vitality and counters.
NPC presets you can save and reuse from one scene to the next.
Stats and counters inherited from the event template, just like a marker.
No dependency on Glamourer, Penumbra or MCDF.

sections.title: Lobby
items: Alliance mode gives way to the lobby: one code, and every table joins the session whatever their FFXIV party.
Admission queue: requests reach the GM, who approves or denies a player, or a whole subgroup at once.
Teammates of an approved leader follow without typing anything.
Promote players to co-GM, remove them, and come back after a drop without losing the room.

sections.title: Turn-based combat
items: Shared initiative order, with turn groups and automatic insertion of a player arriving mid-scene.
Interactive tactical bar, portraits behind the cards and floating health bars.
Overhead camera during combat, restored when it ends.
Movement allowance per turn, drawn on the ground, and an "end my turn" button for players.

sections.title: Dice and templates
items: Two ways to resolve a stat: as a modifier added to the die, or as a threshold to stay under.
The GM can request a roll from a player, choosing the stat and the success threshold.
Configurable critical successes and failures, free dice formula.
Shared roll history, with the verdict next to the result.

sections.title: Sheets and profiles
items: Character sheet in its own window, from a right click on a party member.
Portraits and RP profiles taken from UmbraSync when both plugins are installed.
Vitality, shield, ether, custom counters and temporary modifiers.

sections.title: Ashfall Connect
items: Online vault for your sheets, event templates and notes.
Subscribe to a shared template: the table receives its author's updates.
Session notepad, synchronised along with the rest.

sections.title: Atmosphere
items: Weather and in-game time forced for the scene, with detection of other plugins doing the same.
Full-screen GM announcements, and a round announcement between turns.
Automatic death emote at zero hit points, purely cosmetic and optional.

sections.title: Interface
items: Cards, switches and transparency reworked across every tab.
Search in the settings, and a setup assistant on first launch.
Floating button to open the player view, name plates hidden during combat.
Interface available in French and English.

sections.title: Under the hood
items: New 2.0 relay, compatible with 1.4.1 clients during the transition.
Session recovery after a hard disconnect, for GM and players alike.
Privacy and AI usage declarations updated in the repository.
